description: This file defines the BackgroundSyncConfig interface, which extends BackgroundStreamingConfig and provides configuration methods and constants for background synchronization settings within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: BackgroundSyncConfig
classes.description: An interface specifying the configuration parameters for background synchronization in Eclipse Ditto, including methods to retrieve configuration values and an enumeration of default config values.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the Typesafe Config object containing the background sync configuration.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the background sync is enabled.

methods.name: getQuietPeriod
methods.description: Returns the duration representing the quiet period before starting background sync after startup, and between flushes.

methods.name: getKeptEvents
methods.description: Returns the number of events to keep in the actor state.

methods.name: getToleranceWindow
methods.description: Returns the duration specifying out-of-date search index entry tolerance.

methods.name: getThrottleThroughput
methods.description: Returns how many things to update per throttle period.

methods.name: getThrottlePeriod
methods.description: Returns the duration of the throttle period.

methods.name: getIdleTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration to wait before considering the stream stalled.

methods.name: getPolicyAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration to wait for policy shard region responses.

methods.name: getMinBackoff
methods.description: Returns the minimum backoff duration on stream failure.

methods.name: getMaxBackoff
methods.description: Returns the maximum backoff duration on stream failure.

methods.name: getMaxRestarts
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of restarts after repeated upstream failure.

methods.name: getRecovery
methods.description: Returns the duration that the stream must run error-free before resetting back-off.
